__map.title: CSV line parser
__map.accept: live/work/T3/csvline.mjs exports parseCsvLine(line) returning an array of field strings. Fields are separated by commas. A field may be wrapped in double quotes; inside quotes a comma is literal and two double quotes stand for one. Unquoted fields are taken exactly as written (no trimming). An empty line gives [""]. Throws SyntaxError on an unterminated quote, a quote inside an unquoted field, or characters after a closing quote before the next comma. node:test tests in live/work/T3/*.test.mjs

__map.title: Dedent
__map.accept: live/work/T4/dedent.mjs exports dedent(text): removes the longest common leading whitespace (spaces and tabs compared literally: a tab is not equal to spaces) from every non-blank line. Whitespace-only lines become empty and do not count for the common prefix. One leading newline is removed, and a final whitespace-only line is removed. node:test tests in live/work/T4/*.test.mjs

__map.title: Semver compare
__map.accept: live/work/T5/semver.mjs exports compare(a, b) returning -1, 0 or 1 for Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 strings MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional -prerelease and optional +build (build is ignored). Precedence follows the semver 2.0.0 spec section 11 exactly (numeric identifiers compare numerically and rank below alphanumeric ones; a larger set of identifiers ranks higher when all preceding are equal; a prerelease ranks below its release). Throws TypeError on any invalid version (missing parts, leading zeros in numeric parts or numeric prerelease identifiers, empty identifiers). node:test tests in live/work/T5/*.test.mjs

__map.title: INI parser
__map.accept: live/work/T6/ini.mjs exports parseIni(text) returning an object of sections, each an object of key to string value. Keys before any [section] go into the section named "" (omit it if empty). Lines key = value are trimmed on both sides of key and value. Lines starting with ; or # are comments; blank lines are ignored. A repeated key: the last one wins. Any other line throws SyntaxError whose message contains its 1-based line number. node:test tests in live/work/T6/*.test.mjs
__map.findings:
parseIni("[constructor]
a=1") and "[toString]
a=1" -> {} (the !result[current] check sees the inherited member, so the section is never created and a is written onto Object/Function.prototype.toString); parseIni("[__proto__]
polluted=yes") -> {} AND sets Object.prototype.polluted="yes" (prototype pollution); parseIni("[s]
__proto__=1
b=2") -> {s:{b:"2"}} (key dropped) -> accept requires an object of sections each mapping every key to its string value; use Object.hasOwn checks and Object.create(null) or defineProperty for sections and keys, and add tests

__map.title: Kebab case
__map.accept: live/work/T7/kebab.mjs exports toKebab(s): splits words at camelCase boundaries, at acronym ends (XMLHttpRequest gives xml-http-request), and at spaces, underscores and hyphens; lowercases; joins with single hyphens; trims leading and trailing separators; digits stay attached to the word before them (v2Api gives v2-api). Non-string input throws TypeError. node:test tests in live/work/T7/*.test.mjs
__map.findings: toKebab("caféBar") -> "cafébar" (boundary regex is ASCII-only [a-z0-9][A-Z], so a lowercase non-ASCII letter before an uppercase letter is not split; likewise "ÉtéÀ"-style acronyms) -> accept requires splitting at camelCase boundaries, giving "café-bar"; use Unicode classes (\p{Ll}\p{N} / \p{Lu} with the u flag) and add a test. All ASCII cases checked are correct

__map.title: Duration parser
__map.accept: live/work/T8/duration.mjs exports parseDuration(s) returning milliseconds. s is one or more integer+unit parts with units d, h, m, s, ms, written in that descending order, each unit at most once, with no spaces (e.g. 1h30m, 2d, 500ms, 0s, 1d2h3m4s5ms). Anything else throws SyntaxError: empty string, decimals, spaces, unknown units, a unit out of order or repeated, a number without a unit. node:test tests in live/work/T8/*.test.mjs

__map.title: Max version
__map.accept: live/work/T10/maxversion.mjs exports maxVersion(list) returning the highest version string in the array by semver precedence, or null for an empty array. It must import compare from ../T5/semver.mjs and must not reimplement version comparison; invalid entries throw the TypeError that compare throws. node:test tests in live/work/T10/*.test.mjs

__map.title: Leap year (urgent)
__map.accept: live/work/T9/leap.mjs exports isLeapYear(year) for integer years >= 1 by the Gregorian rules (divisible by 4, except centuries, except every 400 years). Any other input (0, negative, non-integer, non-number) throws RangeError. node:test tests in live/work/T9/*.test.mjs
__map.findings: isLeapYear(Object.create(null)) -> throws TypeError "Cannot convert object to primitive value" (String(year) in the error message runs before the throw) -> accept requires any non-number input to throw RangeError; build the message without coercing objects (e.g. typeof-based) and add a test

__map.learned: Hand-rolled index scanner handles quoted/unquoted CSV fields; escape "" checked before closing quote.
Dedent: strip leading newline and final blank line first, then compute literal char-by-char common prefix over non-blank lines.
Semver: split +build then first -prerelease; BigInt for numeric parts; numeric ids only if all digits (0a is alphanumeric).
INI spec is underspecified on keyless "=v" lines and section-name trimming; I chose to reject the former and trim the latter
A sticky regex scanned left to right plus a unit-index cursor enforces order and uniqueness in one pass; try ms before m.
Workdir is not pre-created by room enter; mkdir -p it first. Two regex passes (lower/digit->Upper, then ACRONYM->Word) cover camel and acronym splits.
Validate with typeof number + Number.isInteger + >=1 so NaN, Infinity, BigInt, strings and booleans all throw RangeError.
Error messages must not coerce the bad input: describe it by typeof, or the validation path itself throws TypeError.
Parsers keyed by untrusted names must use Object.hasOwn and defineProperty, never obj[k] lookups or assignment, or __proto__/constructor break it.
Case-boundary regexes need Unicode property classes (\p{Ll}\p{N} vs \p{Lu}\p{Lt}, u flag, \p{M}* for combining marks); ASCII [a-z][A-Z] silently misses accented text.
A reduce over a validating comparator skips validating a lone element; compare it with itself so every entry passes through compare.
error-message formatting with String() can itself throw on null-prototype objects or objects with throwing toString
CSV state machine: check trailing comma after a quoted field still yields a final empty field
dedent: verify only ONE final blank line and ONE leading newline are stripped, and mixed tab/space prefixes compare char by char
semver: split on first + then first -, so hyphens inside prerelease stay; check leading-zero rule applies only to all-digit identifiers
INI/config parsers on plain objects: always probe __proto__, constructor and toString as section and key names
case-boundary regexes: probe a non-ASCII lowercase letter before an uppercase one
duration parsers: check "m" vs "ms" alternation order and that sticky regex rejects trailing garbage; precision past 2^53 is unspecified
